ocr.description: Dedicated OCR helper inside the managed-document command owner; frozen after canonical bc250 dispatcher migration.

Translation integrity is ordered, clause-local and polarity-aware.

quality-history.description: Historical quality-check result snapshots retained for evidence provenance, not current routine reasoning.

test-suite.description: Broad pre-1.0 regression suite. Preserve existing behavior coverage while allowing implementation cleanup.
notes: All tests/test_*.py modules remain part of advisory repository validation.
RPM %check runs the package-critical list declared in release-contract.json.
Fix brittle fixtures/isolation when implementation changes; do not delete tests solely to reduce noise.

verification-diagnostics.description: Verifier, human/JSON status, health diagnostics, support bundles and LAN verification.

policy.description: Keep the complete package source, but narrow routine integration work to active components. Frozen and archive-only components are verified by baseline tree hash and are not routinely reread or retested unless explicitly thawed or a boundary dependency changes.

full_release_gate.note: Frozen status reduces routine iteration only. Current-release governance, Ruff, ShellCheck, package-critical tests, configured rpmlint, payload/source integrity and artifact identity are blocking. The broad behavioral suite remains additional/advisory evidence unless a finding is promoted to a release-critical defect.

routine_start: Read this manifest before broad development handovers.
Map changed files with development/scope.py map.
Work only in active components plus any boundary-active component crossed by the change.
Do not inspect or run dedicated tests for frozen/archive-only components when their baseline hashes are unchanged.
Run the full deterministic/package/release gates only at a release milestone or when explicitly requested.

status_meaning.active: Routine current development surface; inspect and run focused tests when relevant.
status_meaning.archive_only: Historical evidence/source retained for provenance; do not load during routine current-state reasoning.
status_meaning.boundary_active: Normally stable interface layer; inspect/test only when an active change crosses its boundary or the component itself changes.
status_meaning.frozen: Retained unchanged in package; verify tree hash only during routine work. Thaw before intentional edits.
